substantive_difference: Old near_apex_three_paths drew three candidate connectors to 1L and was rejected before calls for a contradictory internal connector. Old tangent_endpoint_pairs marked the four far upper/lower endpoints in red/blue and predicted 2, but full raw finals were 7 and 4, both misses. This uses neither new connector nor marked upper/lower tangent endpoint pair. It compares the incident sloping-edge motifs at the two unmarked leftward tips, replacing tangent-count collapse with same-shape-tip attachment-role substitution. Preset 1 is fixed from this new tip-pair hypothesis, not a relabel of either old result.
